entry.text: The daily turn is already in — a low formed ~7 day(s) ago @ 16.83 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.
